name: Mailgun Mailing Lists
description: Support for the Mailgun Mailing lists.
project_description:
Mailgun module provides integration with the Mailgun email service.

The module uses Mailgun's Official SDK for PHP .

 Mailgun is email automation created for developers. It uses REST APIs to effortlessly send, receive and track emails.

 Mailgun features 
 
 Sending Email 
 Logs 
 Analytics
